CREATE TRIGGER "trg_order_revision_fence" BEFORE UPDATE ON "order" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."revision" IS NOT OLD."revision" + 1 AND (
  NEW."revision" IS NOT OLD."revision"
  OR NEW."note" IS NOT OLD."note"
  OR NEW."customer_id" IS NOT OLD."customer_id")
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'order.revision is fenced: an update that changes a column it covers must add one to it, and any other must keep it or add one');
END
steps.subject: trigger/order/trg_order_revision_fence
